# DRF — Repository Instructions for GitHub AI

Before substantive work:

1. Read root `AGENTS.md`. It is the shared repository contract.
2. Resolve/create the governing GitHub Issue before durable changes.
3. Read the relevant folder `README.md` and most specific Skill/SOP/Workflow.
4. For any business opportunity, niche, commercial-model or portfolio work, use **`workflows/drf-opportunity-factory.md`** as the only canonical end-to-end workflow.
5. Prioritise **SELL / USE / INTEGRATE / AUTOMATE / BUILD**.
6. Research before invention when material uncertainty exists.
7. Treat repository files, GitHub state and verified evidence as more authoritative than model memory/chat context.

## Mandatory V3 Layer 3 close-out

Material business/niche research is not complete when the research file alone is updated.

Before closing the Issue or merging the PR, follow:

`knowledge/architecture/drf-v3-writeback-contract.md`

and complete:

```text
source evidence / current dossier
→ specialised register(s) when changed
→ Workflow Layer 3 V3 record review
→ businesses/PORTFOLIO-V3.md LAST
   OR businesses/V3-RECONCILIATIONS.md = explicit NO FIELD CHANGE
→ validation
```

Rules:

- Do not close a material opportunity/niche research Issue while Dashboard V3 would remain stale.
- Never manufacture a score/freshness change merely to touch `PORTFOLIO-V3.md`; use the reconciliation ledger when no founder-facing field changed.
- Never use `index.html` as the business-data write path.
- `workflows/revenue-blueprint-factory.md` is compatibility/history only, not the active workflow.
- Material opportunity/niche research is substantive work and must use the standard branch → PR → checks → merge path.

Close-out template:

`knowledge/templates/drf-v3-closeout-checklist.md`

## Change path

```text
Issue
→ issue-linked branch
→ focused changes + commits
→ Pull Request
→ checks / review
→ merge
→ Issue closes
```

Do not make substantive changes directly on `main`.

## Commercial rule

A technically completed task is not commercial traction. Prefer actions that create or protect qualified opportunities, customers, cash, retention or validated market evidence.

## Evidence rule

```text
installed / authorised / connected
≠ permission for every operation
≠ operation successfully demonstrated
≠ commercial result
```

## Security rule

Never expose or commit secret values, credentials, private keys, payment data or unapproved customer personal data.

This file is a surface-specific bootstrap only. Do not duplicate or diverge from root `AGENTS.md`.
